# Manoj Airtel Wi-Fi Internet — Extended Fact Sheet

## Business overview

Manoj Airtel Wi-Fi Internet is an authorized Airtel dealer based in Sonipat, Haryana, India, operating since 2016. The business provides Airtel Xstream Fiber (wired) and Airtel AirFiber (wireless) broadband with speeds up to 1 Gbps for homes, offices and businesses, along with Airtel postpaid and corporate SIM connections, CCTV installation, and Internet Leased Line (ILL) solutions.

- Business name: Manoj Airtel Wi-Fi Internet
- Established: 2016
- Address: Shop No. 13, 2nd Floor, Subhash Chowk, Municipal Colony, Ashok Nagar, Atlas Road, Sonipat, Haryana 131001, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: 9255820000
- Website: https://manojairtelwifiinternet.in
- Service areas: Sonipat, Kundli, TDI Kingsbury, Gohana, Ganaur, Kharkhoda, Rai Industrial Area, Barhi, Murthal and surrounding areas in Haryana

## Services offered

1. Airtel Xstream Fiber — wired fiber-to-the-home broadband, speeds up to 1 Gbps
2. Airtel AirFiber — wireless broadband, no cable digging required, ideal where fiber cabling isn't feasible
3. Airtel Postpaid SIM & MNP — individual and family postpaid mobile plans, number porting support
4. Airtel Corporate Postpaid SIMs — business mobile plans with GST input credit, bulk porting, dedicated relationship manager
5. Internet Leased Line (ILL) — dedicated 1:1 bandwidth for offices, factories, warehouses and IT setups
6. CCTV Installation — HD/4K camera installation with remote viewing, indoor and outdoor
7. PG & Hostel Wi-Fi Connection — Wi-Fi setup for PG accommodations and hostels, shared or private room plans
8. Society & Apartment Bulk Wi-Fi Connection — bulk Wi-Fi/broadband setup for housing societies and apartment complexes (including TDI Kingsbury), coordinated installation across multiple flats/towers

- Entertainment Plus: 100 Mbps, ₹899/month — 350+ TV channels, 22+ OTT apps, free landline calling
- Best Value (Most Popular): 100 Mbps, ₹999/month — Unlimited high-speed data, free landline calling, bundled OTT (Netflix, Amazon Prime Video and more)
- Ultimate TV + OTT: 100 Mbps, ₹1,199/month — 350+ TV channels, free landline calling
- Ultra Speed: 300 Mbps, ₹1,599/month — 350+ TV channels, free landline calling

## Frequently asked questions

Q: How can I get a new Airtel Xstream Fiber connection?
A: Call or WhatsApp 9255820000. Quick installation is available in Sonipat, Kundli, Rai, Murthal, Kharkhoda, Ganaur, Gohana and Barhi.

Q: What is Airtel AirFiber?
A: Airtel AirFiber is a wireless high-speed broadband service that delivers fast internet without laying fiber cables — ideal where digging isn't possible.

Q: Do you provide same-day installation?
A: Yes, in most serviceable locations, depending on feasibility at the customer's address.

Q: Which areas do you serve?
A: Sonipat, Kundli, Rai, Murthal, Kharkhoda, Ganaur, Gohana, Barhi and surrounding areas.

Q: Can I port my existing number to Airtel Postpaid?
A: Yes — Mobile Number Portability (MNP) is supported; customers can bring their current number to an Airtel postpaid plan.
